exercises.title: U6 听力·对话 Planning a Trip to the Terraces
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lucy: Have you decided where to go this holiday, Tom?
Tom: I'd love to see the Longji Rice Terraces in Guangxi.
Lucy: The terraces on the mountains? Why do you want to go there?
Tom: They were built hundreds of years ago, and they show how people work with nature.
Lucy: That sounds amazing. When is the best time to visit?
Tom: In autumn, when the rice turns gold all over the mountains.
Lucy: Lovely! Should we walk to the top?
Tom: Yes. From the very top you can see the terraces reaching as far as the eye can see.
Lucy: Then let's book the trip for October!
exercises.translation_cn: Lucy 问 Tom 假期想去哪;Tom 想去广西龙脊梯田,因为梯田有几百年历史、展现人与自然的合作;最佳季节是秋天,水稻金黄铺满群山;两人决定爬到山顶看一望无际的梯田,定在十月出行。

questions.stem: Where does Tom want to go this holiday?

options: They are the cheapest place to visit.
They show how people work with nature.
They are very close to his home.

questions.stem: When is the best time to see them?
options: In autumn, when the rice turns gold.

questions.stem: What can they see from the top of the mountains?
options: Terraces reaching far into the distance.

questions.stem: When do they decide to take the trip?

exercises.title: U6 听力·短文 The Great Barrier Reef
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The Great Barrier Reef lies off the coast of Australia.
It is the largest structure on Earth made by living things.
Tiny sea organisms built it slowly over millions of years.
Many kinds of fish and turtles make their home there.
Warmer and dirtier seas now put this natural wonder in danger.
exercises.translation_cn: 大堡礁位于澳大利亚海岸外;它是地球上由生物造出的最大结构;微小的海洋生物历经数百万年慢慢建成;许多种鱼和海龟在此安家;如今变暖、变脏的海水使这一自然奇观陷入危险。

questions.stem: Where is the Great Barrier Reef?
options: In the middle of a desert.

questions.stem: What makes the reef special?
options: It is the largest structure made by living things.
It was built by famous engineers.
It is made only of stone.
It is the smallest reef on Earth.

questions.stem: Who built the reef?
What lives on the reef?
What now puts the reef in danger?

exercises.title: U6 听力·对话 A New Gardening Hobby
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Anna: You look happy today, Ben. What have you been doing?
Ben: I started a small garden on our rooftop last month.
Anna: On the rooftop? But your flat has no garden at all.
Ben: That's the point. There was no space on the ground, so I used the roof.
Anna: What do you grow up there?
Ben: Some vegetables and a lot of flowers. I water them every morning.
Anna: Does it really help in any way?
Ben: Yes. It makes the air cleaner and keeps the top floor cooler in summer.
Anna: That's wonderful. Maybe I'll try it on my roof too!
exercises.translation_cn: Anna 见 Ben 很开心;Ben 上月在自家屋顶上开辟了小花园;因为地面没空间,就利用了屋顶;他种了些蔬菜和很多花,每天早上浇水;屋顶花园让空气更清新、夏天顶楼更凉快;Anna 也想在自家屋顶试试。

questions.stem: What did Ben start last month?
options: A small garden on his rooftop.

questions.stem: Why did Ben use the roof?
options: There was no space on the ground.
He wanted to hide the plants.

questions.stem: What does Ben grow there?
How does the garden help?
options: It uses up all the water.
It cleans the air and cools the top floor.

questions.stem: What does Anna decide to do?
options: Try a garden on her own roof.

exercises.title: U6 听力·短文 Life in the Arctic
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The Inuit live in the cold, frozen lands of the Arctic.
Almost no crops grow there, so they eat a lot of fish and meat.
Such food keeps their bodies strong in the freezing weather.
For part of the year the sun never rises at all.
This long polar night gives families more time together.
exercises.translation_cn: 因纽特人生活在寒冷冰封的北极;那里几乎不长庄稼,所以他们多吃鱼和肉;这种食物让身体在严寒中保持强壮;一年中有一段时间太阳根本不升起;漫长的极夜让家人有更多相处的时光。

questions.stem: Where do the Inuit live?
Why do they eat a lot of fish and meat?

options: It keeps their bodies strong in the cold.

questions.stem: What happens for part of the year?

exercises.title: U6 听力·对话 Buying Herbal Tea
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Shopkeeper: Good morning! Can I help you find something?
Mia: Yes, please. I'm looking for some herbal tea.
Shopkeeper: We have many kinds. Are you looking for a special benefit?
Mia: I haven't been sleeping well lately.
Shopkeeper: Then try this one. It helps you relax at night.
Mia: That sounds perfect. Is it made from natural plants?
Shopkeeper: Yes, from herbs and flowers, with no chemicals at all.
Mia: Wonderful. I'll take two boxes, please.
Shopkeeper: Good choice. Drink a warm cup before bed.
exercises.translation_cn: 店员问需要什么;Mia 想买花草茶;店员问是否要某种功效;Mia 说近来睡眠不好;店员推荐一款助眠茶;Mia 问是否纯天然;店员说由香草和花制成、无任何化学品;Mia 买了两盒,店员建议睡前喝一杯温茶。

questions.stem: What does Mia want to buy?

options: She has not been sleeping well.

questions.stem: What does the shopkeeper say the tea does?
options: It helps her relax at night.

exercises.title: U6 听力·短文 The Grand Canyon
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The Grand Canyon is a huge valley in the United States.
It is almost two kilometres deep in some places.
A great river slowly cut it from the rock over millions of years.
Brave visitors can stand on a narrow glass platform.
From there they look straight down into the deep canyon below.
exercises.translation_cn: 大峡谷是美国的一道巨大山谷;某些地方近两千米深;一条大河历经数百万年慢慢在岩石中切出了它;勇敢的游客可以站在狭窄的玻璃平台上;从那里直直地俯视下方的深谷。

questions.stem: What is the Grand Canyon?
options: A tall building in a city.
A huge valley in the United States.

questions.stem: How deep is it in some places?

options: People dug it out by hand.
A river slowly cut it from the rock.

questions.stem: Where can brave visitors stand?
options: On the top of a tree.

questions.stem: What do visitors do from there?
